description: This file defines interfaces related to serialization codecs in the Orleans framework, including base codec interfaces, generalized codecs, and specialized codecs, focusing on serialization/deserialization of type hierarchies.

classes.name: IBaseCodec<in T>
classes.description: Interface for serializing and deserializing members of a type hierarchy for a specific type T.

classes.name: IGeneralizedBaseCodec
classes.description: Interface for a base type serializer supporting multiple types, capable of checking if a type is supported.

classes.name: ISpecializableBaseCodec
classes.description: Interface for creating codecs that support specific types, with methods to check support and retrieve specialized codecs.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value of type T using a buffer writer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into a value of type T from a reader.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a given type is supported by the codec.

methods.name: GetSpecializedCodec
methods.description: Retrieves a codec specialized for a specific type.
